title: Messi 2021: deserved, or the robbery of Lewandowski and Jorginho?
checked: Barca 2020-21: Messi 30 Liga goals, Pichichi, Copa del Rey; Liga table Atletico 86, Real 84, Barcelona 79 (Wikipedia La Liga 2020-21, FC Barcelona, Goal). Copa America 2021: free kick v Chile, 14 June, Rio, 33', 1-1 (Al Jazeera, BA Times); 2 v Bolivia, one a penalty, 28 June, Cuiaba, 4-1 (Ahram/Reuters, SoccerNews); free kick and 2 assists v Ecuador QF, 3-0, 3 July (FotMob, AOL/Reuters); 4 goals 5 assists, best player shared with Neymar (CONMEBOL, Fox). Final 10 July 2021, Maracana, 1-0 Brazil, Di Maria chip over Ederson from De Paul's long pass, 22', Argentina's first title in 28 years (CONMEBOL, Planet Football, Vavel, CBS). First Ligue 1 goal 20 Nov 2021 v Nantes; ceremony 29 Nov 2021 (CBS, Ligue1.com, Topend). Lewandowski 41 beats Muller's 40 (TNT, Gulf News). Jorginho: Champions League with Chelsea, Euro 2020 with Italy, UEFA Men's Player of the Year (Wikipedia, TNT). Vote 613/580/460 (Topend, TNT). Framed as a debate, no claim of wrongdoing. Gameplay: the Chile free kick and Di Maria's chip, gamecap specs/rob-messi-2021*.json; Argentina's stripes show as one sky blue on the figures.

lines.text: 2021. Messi wins his seventh Ballon d'Or. But was it his to win, or was somebody robbed?

scene.headline: Messi finally scores in Ligue 1
scene.standfirst: Three months after arriving from Barcelona, his first league goal for PSG comes against Nantes.

lines.text: Now the rivals. Lewandowski. Forty-one Bundesliga goals, beating Gerd Müller's record.
lines.say: Now the rivals. Lehvandoffskee. Forty one Bundesliga goals, beating Gaird Mewler's record.

lines.text: And Jorginho. The Champions League with Chelsea. The Euros with Italy. UEFA's player of the year.
lines.say: And Zhorjeenyo. The Champions League with Chelsea. The Euros with Italy. Yooayfuh's player of the year.

lines.text: The result? Messi six hundred and thirteen. Lewandowski five hundred and eighty. Jorginho four hundred and sixty.
lines.say: The result? Messi six hundred and thirteen. Lehvandoffskee five hundred and eighty. Zhorjeenyo four hundred and sixty.

lines.text: The case for Messi? He finally won with Argentina, and he carried them there.
lines.say: The case for Messi? He finally won with Argentina, and he carried them there.

lines.text: The case against? Forty-one goals. Or the two biggest trophies in the game. Deserved, or robbed? You decide.
